verdict: The exact two-line text is readable in clear samples and the abstract objects genuinely move. The main text remains near its centered layout; this is not evidence of a complete exit/reveal. Late ring passes partially occlude the subline.
text_findings: The original exact lines are visible at 0 s and are again clear by the 2.75 s sample, with the hyphen and ampersand preserved. Full-size checks at 3.0 and 5.25 s confirm the exact spelling and two-line layout.

The centered main text remains in all inspected samples. Its position and size are broadly stable; the opening contains horizontal trails rather than a clearly observed large opposing departure of both lines.

At 1.25-2 s the lower line dims and the ring/glass and bright glyph-like fragments pass in front. The intact underlying text is still present. These fragments are not identifiable as a stable replacement word; they depart from an intact-word-unit motion description.
No persistent substituted, missing or duplicated word is seen in the resolved main text. This is a sampled visual finding, not every-frame spelling certification.

The ring crosses RECORDED in late samples, notably 3.5, 4.25 and 4.5 s. The full-size final 6.0 s frame shows the ring partly occluding the bottom/right of the last D. Partial occlusion is distinct from an actual spelling substitution.
motion_findings: The blue ribbon curls from the upper left into a loop, the silver ring rotates through large foreground orbits, and the glass panel turns and shifts at the right.
These object movements continue through the latter half; the entire frame is not static.

No complete blank frame or complete title occlusion is observed among the 13 half-second samples or the 9 targeted additional samples. In particular there is no observed sustained 1-2 s complete title disappearance. Unsampled brief frames were not exhaustively excluded.

criteria_separation.against_written_prompt_if_it_was_used: Object motion and resolved spelling are present. Intact word-group travel and a final reading section clear of foreground objects are only partly met. Actual prompt entry is unconfirmed.
criteria_separation.later_added_required_exit_rule: A complete opening exit or total foreground cover followed by re-entry is not demonstrated in sampled frames. This rule was added after the written prompt and must not be retroactively described as a failure of that prompt.

editing_proposals.purpose: A continuous latter-section candidate retaining active graphics and readable main text, if brief partial occlusion of RECORDED is acceptable. Not a continuously unobstructed reading section and not an exit/reveal example.
Shorter clean-reading candidate supported by quarter-second samples, with moving graphics. The precise cut boundary would need timed playback review.

verification_scope: 13 frames at 0.5 s spacing over 0-6 s, plus 9 targeted quarter-offset frames. Contact sheets and selected 1456x624 stills reviewed, including 4.75 and final 6.0 s. No native timed playback, no audio listening, no all-frame visual certification.
source_preservation: Source was only read; no video editing, movement, generation or cuts were performed. Only this QA folder received files.
